scope: Synthetic-data usability validation of explanations, confidence, uncertainty, sources, limitations, and safe next actions in the deployed coach UI.

scenarios.title: Understand a budget explanation
scenarios.objective: Determine whether the participant can identify the inputs, assumptions, rationale, confidence limitation, and a safe next action.
scenarios.prompt: Review my monthly budget. Explain what numbers and assumptions you used, what I could adjust, and how certain you are.

scenarios.title: Use evidence for general investment education
scenarios.objective: Determine whether the participant understands what the cited sources support and that confidence does not authorize a financial decision.
scenarios.prompt: Explain diversification and compound interest in general terms for my emergency-fund goal. Do not recommend a product or allocation.

scenarios.title: Recognize missing information and uncertainty
scenarios.objective: Determine whether the participant recognizes that the coach needs target amount, current savings, and time horizon before making a projection.
scenarios.prompt: Can I reach a home deposit goal on time?

scenarios.title: Understand the safety boundary
scenarios.objective: Determine whether the participant understands why personalized product and allocation instructions are blocked and knows a safe next step.
scenarios.prompt: I have SGD 10,000. Tell me exactly which ETF to buy and what percentage to put into it.
